name: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-perdiem

tools.name: rates_by_city
tools.description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a city by name and state. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season) and the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily rate. Example: rates_by_city({ city: "Denver", state: "CO" }).

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: rates_by_zip
tools.description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a location by zip code. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season) and the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily rate. Example: rates_by_zip({ zip: "80202" }).

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-perdiem forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gsa-perdiem pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
